title: Reading the oscilloscope trace
caption: The trace spans 6 divisions at 0.5 V/div, so V_pp = 3 V and V₀ = 1.5 V (V_rms = 1.06 V). One cycle spans 4 divisions at 2 ms/div, so T = 8 ms and f = 125 Hz.
alt: Sine trace of amplitude 1.5 volts and period 8 milliseconds on a grid of 0.5 volts and 2 milliseconds per division.
description: Screen grid: one vertical division is 0.5 V and one horizontal division is 2 ms.
The trace goes 1.5 V above and below zero: 6 divisions peak to peak = 3 V, so V₀ = 1.5 V and V_rms = V₀/√2 = 1.06 V.
One full cycle covers 4 divisions: T = 4 × 2 = 8 ms, so f = 1/T = 125 Hz.

checks.name: the peak is 1.5 V (3.0 V peak to peak)
